description: The PGT embryo-call parity cases (REQ-PGT-005): haplotypeRisk.test.ts runs them through frontend/src/lib/haplotypeRisk.ts and backend/tests/test_pgt_embryo_calls.py through backend/app/services/pgt_embryo_calls.py; both must give each case's model and calls. The inheritance model is resolved first (resolveHaplotypeInheritanceModel / resolve_inheritance_model). Synthetic: no person, sample or family is real.

cases.name: dominant: an affected father and child share paternal homolog 1
dominant: one affected member resolves no haplotype
recessive: an affected child resolves paternal 1 and maternal 0
recessive, a donor family: one side resolves, so no embryo is called
X-linked recessive: an affected son, a carrier daughter and an unaffected son
lineage tags: the father's mother, stored as a mother, carries his paternal homolog
dominant: an affected relative grey on both lanes does not collapse the call
recessive: an affected relative grey on both lanes does not zero a side
dominant: a negative call needs the embryo's own haplotype across the ROI
dominant: an unconfirmed side two affected children share is no disease haplotype
dominant: a single-position ROI is read from the block around it
recessive: a carrier or unaffected call needs the other side seen across the ROI
X-linked recessive from an affected son: a son on his maternal X, a daughter carrier on hers
X-linked dominant from an affected father and daughter: a son on his maternal X
X-linked recessive, sex not recorded, from an affected son
X-linked recessive, sex not recorded, from an affected father
pseudo-autosomal dominant: a son is read on both copies in PAR1
pseudo-autosomal dominant: an ROI across the PAR1 boundary needs the son's paternal side throughout
X-linked dominant where the assembly's PARs are not known: a son is read on both lanes
no members and no blocks: nothing is resolved and the embryo is uninformative
dominant: an obligate carrier counts, and a member recorded as no carrier removes a candidate
dominant: two shared candidates and no member recorded as no carrier resolve nothing
no model recorded and a member marked a carrier: recessive
a model CoGA does not read, and no carrier: dominant
X-linked recessive from affected females: a risk haplotype on each side
recessive without an affected member: nothing is resolved
an ROI whose end lies before its start: no negative call
